steps.npc: Why, what brings you to my house, young [man/lady]?
Me? Well, let's see... I live here. So I suppose I'm your host, as long as you're in my house.
I used to work down at the beach, running the charcoal furnaces, but I've handed all that business to my son now. He's a good boy.
Anyway, retiring isn't too bad. There's plenty of warmth from the lava pits, and my boy helps me carry my shopping from Munty's shop. I'll be alright.
But you've never told me what you're doing in my house, young [man/lady]. Don't think I've forgotten!

options.text: Have you got anything to trade?

steps.player: Have you got anything to trade?

steps.npc: Oh, are you a door-to-door [salesman/saleswoman]? My boy said I shouldn't let people like you into the house, and to call the guards if you bothered me.
So why are you in my house anyway?
Be a dear and just wander off now.
